label: ProductForge-Dashboard Backlog 54
title: Operator UI: configure + monitor trials
body:
## Original (as captured)
Create/adjust trial duration, see days remaining, convert/expire trials.

## Context (from linked item product_forge:BI-0064)
Create trial licenses with operator-set duration (days/months) and auto-expiry; enforce on expiry; support conversion to a paid tier.
